parameters.query: SELECT id, policy_code, category, canonical_question, answer_text, paraphrases, conditions, effective_from, effective_to, version, source_title, source_section, owner, approved, sensitivity, synthetic FROM hr.policy_item WHERE approved = true AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY policy_code ASC;

WITH batch AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
    policy_code text,
    title text,
    content text,
    content_hash text,
    token_count integer,
    metadata jsonb,
    source_uri text,
    sensitivity text,
    embedding_vector text
  )
),
upsert_docs AS (
  INSERT INTO rag.document (
    source_type, external_id, title, project_code, content_hash, source_uri, sensitivity, is_active, metadata
  )
  SELECT 
    'hr_policy',
    b.policy_code,
    b.title,
    'HR_POLICY',
    b.content_hash,
    b.source_uri,
    b.sensitivity,
    true,
    b.metadata
  FROM batch b
  ON CONFLICT (source_type, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
    sensitivity = EXCLUDED.sensitivity,
    is_active = true,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    created_at = now()
  RETURNING id, external_id
),
delete_old_chunks AS (
  DELETE FROM rag.chunk
  WHERE document_id IN (SELECT id FROM upsert_docs)
),
insert_chunks AS (
  INSERT INTO rag.chunk (
    document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, embedding_model, embedding_dimension, embedding, metadata
  )
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    0,
    b.content,
    b.token_count,
    'qwen3-embedding:0.6b',
    1024,
    b.embedding_vector::vector,
    b.metadata
  FROM batch b
  JOIN upsert_docs u ON b.policy_code = u.external_id
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS indexed_chunks_count FROM insert_chunks;

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rag.document WHERE source_type = 'hr_policy' AND is_active = true) AS active_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rag.chunk WHERE embedding_model = 'qwen3-embedding:0.6b') AS active_chunks,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'rag' AND indexname = 'idx_rag_chunk_embedding_hnsw') AS hnsw_index_present,
  current_timestamp AS verified_at;
